name: twit.sh

overview.text: twit.sh advertises open-web profile and post data shaped into X v2-compatible JSON, with per-request x402 payments in USDC on Base. This is not proof of official X API affiliation, complete coverage or freshness. Listed examples include $0.005 user lookup, $0.0025 post lookup, $0.006 search and a $0.50 user-insights workflow, so the headline $0.0025 to $0.01 range does not cover every endpoint. Authenticated-user endpoints also advertise posting, deleting, likes, follows and profile updates: the service is not read-only, and paying does not authorize account actions.
